annotation_correction: The quoted -28.9 to -29.4 vehicles is the result of one bounded joint update of five FD/dynamics parameters after spatial subdivision, not a length-only trial. Calibration convergence and adequate congested coverage were not established. This rejects only that candidate for deployment, not calibrated spatial refinement as a model class.
interpretation: In the audited cell18 model trajectories, receiving does not trim the offered flow; investigate computed sending and its density/speed evolution.
For two-zone90, native integrated Nv/L changes by about +31.47 vehicles and measured mainline exit by +31. Spatial storage correction alone cannot explain the model negative response.
For single-zone90, the native Nv/L contrast is about -2.36 while mainline exit changes by +6; within-cell storage position matters for this small contrast.
Recorded microscopic interaction/desired-speed fields are useful diagnostic evidence, not future forecast inputs or an identified causal suppression coefficient.
limitations: Five-second samples are correlated within vehicles; sample counts are not independent experiments.
Free/Follow/Brake labels are recorded native states, not inferred from a speed threshold.
A matched vehicle is not a controlled microscopic counterfactual after leaders/gaps diverge.
Similar-current-state filters are descriptive and condition on post-intervention quantities.
No causal coefficient or universal suppression rule is identified by this comparison.
Resource availability is a model request; no restriction means the receiving constraint did not reduce it, not that native capacity is unlimited.
Five-second velocity quadrature and rounded FZP positions/speeds are approximate; left/right are numerical choices, not confidence bounds.
No unobserved source or deletion inside cell18 is assumed in the identity; residual is retained rather than assigned to normal outflow.
Off-ramp source is inside cell18, not at its downstream face. Its actual position and separate detector counts are retained.
First-meter detector storage corrections retain the original no-unobserved-loss-in-that-meter qualification.
